current_snapshot.final_audit: All 30 exact-head check runs are terminal success across four actual workflow runs. Hosted Tauri workflow supplies Rust-source execution evidence; the focused local 13-test portability command is Python-only. Windows Qt log confirms Core and Qt suite totals, named skips, unsigned build, bounded frozen smoke results, and successful artifact upload. Windows recovery publication smoke was refusal-only and is not counted as a qualified publication.
